transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what finally made me come in and ask for help is... I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to actually like, and I end up throwing most of it away. I just don't have an appetite at all.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

I wouldn't really say I feel sad. Um... I don't know, I haven't really noticed feeling down most of the time. I'm not crying or anything like that. It's mostly just the food thing I mentioned, really.
Have you lost any weight recently?

Yeah, I think so. Like I was saying, I just really don't want to eat lately. I'll just sit there on my break, looking at a sandwich or whatever, and I just can't bring myself to eat it. So I end up throwing it out. I'm pretty sure I've dropped some weight because of it.
How much weight do you think you've lost?
I'm not really sure, honestly. I don't own a scale, so I haven't weighed myself or anything. I just know my clothes are fitting a bit looser than they used to.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future lately?
No, not really. I mean... I don't really think about the future all that much, honestly. I just go to work at the store and get through my shifts. So, no, I wouldn't say I feel hopeless about it.
Are you enjoying activities or hobbies that you normally like to do?

Not really, no. I used to get pretty excited about going to gallery nights, or playing basketball, even just grabbing food-truck tacos or helping kids with art stuff. But lately... I don't know. If I do go out, I just stand there feeling flat. I usually just end up making an excuse so I can leave early.
How long have you been feeling this way about the things you used to enjoy?

It's been about two months. Yeah, right around two months. It started right after I got this window display award at the store, and the district manager started giving me all this attention. That's when I stopped really wanting to do much else.
Do you feel like you're empty or numb inside most of the time?
No, I wouldn't say empty or numb. I mean, I still feel things... I just don't really have the energy or the interest for the stuff I used to do. But I don't feel completely blank inside.
Would you say you've lost a significant amount of weight, like more than 5% of your body weight, in the past two months?

Yeah, I probably have. Honestly, that's kind of what made me finally ask for help. I just... I barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like, and I just end up throwing most of it away.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No, not at all. It's not about the weight. I just... I don't have any appetite. The thought of eating just doesn't appeal to me right now.
Have you ever felt a period of time where you felt sad or depressed for most of the day?
I mean, yeah, definitely. That's... that's kind of the main thing. I just feel really down and sad most of the day, almost every day lately. It just feels like this heavy cloud I can't shake off.
How long have you been feeling sad and down most of the day?

It's been about two months now. It kind of started right after I got this award for a window display I did at the store. The district manager started giving me all this attention because of it, and... yeah, that's really when this whole feeling started.
Do you feel like you're no longer able to experience pleasure from activities that you used to find enjoyable?

Yeah, definitely. I used to get really excited about doing things... like going out to gallery nights, playing basketball, grabbing food-truck tacos, or even just helping kids out with art stuff. But lately, I just don't feel anything from it. If I do go, I just stand there feeling completely flat. I usually just end up making an excuse to leave early. It's just not fun for me right now.
Do you think your loss of appetite and weight loss are related to concerns about your body shape or weight?

No, it's not about my body or my weight or anything like that. I just... I barely want to eat anymore. Honestly, that's kind of what made me finally ask for help. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like, and I just can't bring myself to eat it. I usually just end up throwing most of it away.
How long have you been feeling sad and down most of the day?
Um, like I mentioned a little bit ago, it's been about two months now. It all kind of started right after I did that window display at the store.
Have you ever felt this sad and down for a long time before the past two months?
No, not really. I mean, I've had bad days before, like anyone else, but never anything like this. This is the first time I've felt this down for this long.
Have you ever had a period of feeling sad and down like this before the past two months?
I think you just asked me that... but no, like I said, I've never felt this way before. Just these last two months.
Have you ever felt this sad and down before in your life, prior to the past two months?
Uh... I feel like we're going in circles here. But no, I haven't. Never in my life before these past two months. This is definitely the first time it's ever been like this.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling sad and down like this before in your life?
I really don't know how else to say it, doc. No. Like I just told you, this is the very first time I've ever felt this way. There haven't been any other times.
Have you had any periods of feeling significantly better between episodes of feeling sad and down?

I... I'm not sure what you mean. Like I said, this is the first time I've ever felt like this. So there haven't been any other episodes to have better periods between. It's just been these past two months, straight through.
